Title: Agent Pay message template issue — Agent Pay / Payment Flow
Description:
We created an agent in Agent Pay and saved a message template for customers.
When creating the agent account, we selected that message template under the Template setting.
After a player submitted a deposit request, we assigned the request to the agent and also assigned the bank account details to the customer.
Our understanding is that once the bank account is assigned to the customer, the selected message template should be automatically sent to that customer.
However, the saved template message was not sent.
Could you please confirm whether this template is intended to be sent automatically, whether the trigger is the bank account assignment step, or if any additional setting / send button is required?
Oritech Team Comment: Template is sent automatically, but it is displayed in transactions. now we will add feature to show it in notifications too.

Title: [Frontend] Deposit Requests Cannot Be Cancelled by Players or Operators
Description:
There is no option for either the player or the backoffice operator to cancel a pending deposit request. This issue affects both crypto and banking deposit requests.

For crypto deposits, the request can remain pending for several hours. While it is pending, the player cannot submit a new deposit request. If the deposit window is closed, the player cannot reopen it to check the wallet address.

A cancellation option is required for both players and backoffice operators.

Oritech Team Comment: Logic is calculated from the bonus amount because of the "Cash prize" bonus logic.

Title: [Backend] Incorrect Balance Returned After Cancelling a Bonus Mid-Play
Description:
The player deposited KRW 50,000 and received a 5% bonus of KRW
, starting Bonus Play with a total balance of KRW 52,500.

The player cancelled the bonus while the remaining displayed balance was KRW 26,500. However, KRW 25,238.10 was transferred to the player's Real Money balance. This amount does not match the remaining balance or the expected calculation.

If the original KRW 2,500 bonus is deducted from the remaining KRW 26,500, we would expect KRW 24,000 to be returned. Please verify the bonus cancellation calculation and clarify the exact formula used.

Title: [Backend] Bonus Bet Amounts Are Not Displayed in Player Logs
Description:
While the player is using Bonus Play, the related log entries are marked as bonus transactions, but the actual wager amounts are not displayed.

Because the Bonus Money balance includes both the player's deposited funds and the bonus amount, operators need to be able to track the amount wagered on each bonus bet. Without this information, it is not possible to verify the player's wagering activity, remaining funds, or the amount returned after bonus cancellation.

Please display the wager amount for each bonus bet in the logs.
